Vision, Values and Ethos
As a school, we have a clear sense of where we are going, and the aspirations we have for our school and wider community. Our vision, revised in December 2023, reflects the shared way forward of our stakeholders. It drives everything that we do as we aspire to meet the needs of all of our pupils.
Our Vision
Our school will be a happy community that encourages and celebrates individuality, where everyone feels safe, valued and inspired to achieve.
Our Values
We will achieve our vision by being values-led as a school. Our core school values are: Aspiration, Fairness, Kindness, Responsibility and Teamwork, which we represent with the following symbols to support the awareness and understanding of all within our school community:
Below, you will see our Values Framework, which identifies the behaviours we support pupils to adopt so that they are 'living out' these values that will set them up for further education and their lives beyond.
School Values Framework pdf
School Information
Vision, Values and Ethos

Welcome
At Blackbrook School, we are dedicated to fostering a nurturing, inclusive, and stimulating environment where every child is encouraged to explore their potential and develop a lifelong love of learning. Our committed team of teachers and staff work collaboratively to ensure that each pupil receives a high-quality education, filled with rich experiences and opportunities for growth.
We believe in creating a school community where respect, kindness, and a strong sense of belonging are at the heart of everything we do. Our curriculum is designed to inspire curiosity, creativity, and critical thinking, preparing our pupils not just for academic success, but for life beyond the classroom.
Having worked as a leader within The Oak Partnership for some time, I am proud to be the Headteacher of this wonderful school. Upon joining, I worked with the staff following the most recent OfSTED inspection to revise our school vision and values, giving us a clear sense of direction for the future. Our collective vision for Blackbrook is:
Our school will be a happy community that encourages and celebrates individuality, where everyone feels safe, valued and inspired to achieve.
We will achieve our vision by living out the following values: Aspiration, Fairness, Kindness, Responsibility and Teamwork.
I invite you to explore our website to learn more about our values, our vibrant school life, and the wonderful achievements of our pupils. Whether you are a current member of our school community or considering joining us, we hope you find the information here helpful and inspiring.
Thank you for visiting our website. Do get in touch if you would like more information.
Mr D. Seviour Headteacher

We hope that you and your child will be very happy during your time here.
This page is your online "Welcome Pack", which includes general information about the school, guidance on our uniform policy as well an academic year calendar.
Please work through the steps below to ensure that you have read key information and have completed the necessary administration required as part of your child's enrolment. Please ensure that this has been completed no later than Wednesday 1st July.
Normal school opening and closing times are 8.50am until 3.15pm. Your child’s first day will be Tuesday 8th September. For their first two days, they will stay until 12pm. The Oak Partnership Trust
Blackbrook School is one of four founding schools of 'The Oak Partnership', a Multi-Academy Trust (MAT) in Somerset.
The Oak Partnership Multi Academy Trust was formed on 1 January 2019. Its founder member schools were three primary schools (Blackbrook Community Primary School, Ruishton CofE Primary School and West Monkton CofE Primary School) and one all-through Special School (Selworthy Special School). All four schools were inspected by Ofsted in 2018 and were rated Good. These schools were reinspected in 2023 and continued to have 'Good' judgements.
In total, the trust accommodates over 1000 learners.
The region in which The Oak Partnership is located is at the heart of one of the biggest and fastest growing housing developments in the South West, located along the M5 corridor. There are pockets of high deprivation within these catchments and the Trust recognises the challenge of encouraging aspiration amongst all within its community. It hopes to be a catalyst for higher standards and improved outcomes for all its learners, therefore enhancing life chances and social mobility throughout the region.

Early Reading
At Blackbrook School, we believe that early reading is pivotal within a child's educational journey. Developing strong reading skills at a young age sets the foundation for lifelong learning, critical thinking, and academic success. We prioritise early reading by incorporating engaging, age-appropriate literature into our curriculum, fostering a love for books, and creating a supportive environment where every child can thrive. Our dedicated staff work closely with pupils to ensure they develop the confidence and skills needed to become proficient readers, empowering them to explore new worlds and ideas through the power of words.
We teach early reading skills using the Read Write Inc. phonics programme.

Blackbrook School use the Read, Write, Inc scheme for all pupils in Reception to Year 2. Pupils access the scheme daily and our taught by our highly skilled team. Year 3 pupils will also remain on the programme if they have not achieved the expected standard.

Childhood Trauma and the Brain
This video, "Childhood Trauma and the Brain" by the UK Trauma Council, explores how early traumatic experiences can affect the developing brain. Using powerful visuals and clear explanations, it breaks down complex neuroscience into something accessible for parents and caregivers. Understanding these impacts is crucial—not just for recognising the signs of trauma, but also for learning how to support healing and resilience in children. If you’re a parent, this is a must-watch to deepen your awareness and become a more trauma-informed support in your child’s life.
